spans.s: घृष् 1. घृष् = हृष्, to be joyful.

घृष् 2. घृष्, cl. 1. P. घर्षति, जघर्-
ष, घर्षिष्यति, घर्षितुम्, to rub,
grind, brush, polish, furbish; crush, pound: Caus. P.
घर्षयति, -यितुम्, to rub, grind.

घृषु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. lively, agile, mirthful,
sportive.

1. घृष्वि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. lively, gay, merry, spor-
tive; (Sāy.) crushing, (as if fr. 2. घृष्.)
—घृष्वि-
राधस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. frolicsome with joy; (Sāy.)
whose gifts touch each other or come closely together,
(as if fr. 2. घृष्); epithet of the Maruts.

घृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed, ground, pounded;
frayed, grazed, rubbed so as to be sore.

घृष्टि, इस्, m. a hog [cf. गृष्टि and 2. घृष्वि];
(इस्), f. grinding, pounding; emulation, contest; N.
of a plant, = वाराही, Lycopodium Imbricatum; N. of
another plant, Clitorea Ternatea; [cf. विष्णु-क्रान्ता.]

घृष्ठिला घृष्ठिला, f., N. of a plant re-
lated to the plant Hemionitis Cordifolia; [cf. पृश्नि-
पर्णी.]
